description:
Send a value for one field of one race, read from a web page — a correction
or a value the index is missing. `field` is a column name from `describe`;
`value` is in that column's form and units (gain_m in metres, dates yyyy-mm-dd,
start_time HH:MM 24h, price_usd a number). `quote` must be copied verbatim from
`source_url` and must show the value. For date, start time, price, aid stations,
drop bags and runners, `year` is the edition year. The server checks the
quote on the page; the result says whether the value was applied, held for a
maintainer, or rejected and why.
name: propose_correction
title: Propose a correction
